bias.en: Bullish · RSI at 70, nearing the record
bias.zh: 看多 · RSI 达 70，逼近纪录高点

read.en: Microsoft rose 1.1% on Oct 12 to $541.15, its second straight gain, and closed above the $537 resistance from the last read. It is above all its averages, all rising: 5-day ($532), 10-day ($524), 30-day ($508), 100-day ($451) and 200-day ($434). MACD has been above its signal since Oct 1, Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Aug 28 ($516.5), and RSI is 70, the overbought line.
read.zh: 微软 10月12日上涨 1.1%，收于 $541.15，连涨两日，收盘站上上次解读中的 $537 阻力。股价位于全部均线上方且均线均向上：5 日（$532）、10 日（$524）、30 日（$508）、100 日（$451）和 200 日（$434）。MACD 自 10月1日起位于信号线上方，抛物线 SAR 自 8月28日起看多（$516.5），RSI 为 70，处于超买线。

read.en: The record zone at $553–555 (Oct 28, 2025 high) is 2% away and is the main test; with RSI at 70, a pause there would be normal. Support is $537 (old resistance), then the 10-day average near $524 and the 30-day near $508; SAR at $516.5 sits between them.
read.zh: $553–555 纪录区（2025年10月28日高点）仅 2% 之遥，是主要考验；RSI 已达 70，在此暂歇属正常。支撑为 $537（原阻力），其次约 $524 的 10 日均线和约 $508 的 30 日均线；$516.5 的 SAR 位于两者之间。
